create_ingress_filter: create an IngressFilter instance from a BPF function to compile a scheduling classifier program
install_ingress_filter: install an IngressFilter BPF program as a drop action on a network device interface
remove_ingress_filter: remove the ingress filter from a network device by calling the IngressFilter remove method
clear_ingress_filter: clear the ingress filter qdisc and BPF rules from a specified network device interface
close_ingress_filter: close an IngressFilter program and release its associated file descriptor resources
